result:
Done. The fix adds `chmod -R 777 dist/` immediately after each artifact download in the CI workflow. This grants world-readable/writable permissions to the downloaded artifacts before tar extraction, so any subsequent CI job (running under a different user) can access them without permission errors.

The four jobs affected are: **tests**, **tests-pypy**, **coverage**, and **docs**—all of which download pre-built packages and need to extract them. This eliminates the permission failure that happens when the artifact-downloading user differs from the artifact-creating user.
